title: A Aftermath for the Undertow
author: Noor Eastwick
blurb: Oscar Halloran, a bridge inspector measuring the marriage in expansion joints, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. Then a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must translate the untranslatable sentence and live with it before the mother's memory goes entirely.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
